title: Parametric Constraints & Associative Editing: the professional constraints subsystem
objective: Deliver the parametric constraints & associative editing subsystem on the frozen CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 (Issue #86; the CAD-PARITY program's next AutoCAD-class subsystem after CAD-PARITY-006 merged at 77d1b4a): a BOUNDED DETERMINISTIC constraint solver for the existing 2D vocabulary (Issue #86 research direction — no general-purpose nonlinear solver, explicit supported constraint graphs with deterministic propagation/solve ordering over black-box numerics; unsupported relationships decline with typed results, never silently approximate), the constraint vocabulary (horizontal, vertical, coincident, parallel, perpendicular, equal, tangent, fixed + the dimensional family: line length, distances, angles, radii), the canonical constraint graph with stable ids + deterministic ordering + immutable revision integration, SIX explicit solve outcomes (solved, under-constrained, over-constrained, unsatisfied, ambiguous, unsupported), associative dimensions/annotations recompute from canonical element identities after supported geometry edits, constraint-aware MOVE/STRETCH/TRIM/EXTEND/ROTATE/COPY where the declared vocabulary supports it (transform edits re-solve with fixed-restore; re-topologizing edits sever the broken constraints — the CAD-PARITY-005 dead-ref precedent), the deterministic ARRAY/pattern family (rectangular + polar with document-minted canonical identities and replay-safe semantics; path arrays are typed declines), constraint diagnostics + the professional Constraints palette on Web and Electron (the SAME shared solver — LOCK-004 parity by construction), the shared glyph painter, save/open/undo/redo/replay persistence with Construction Graph mapping by canonical identity, and Vercel deployed verification of the exact PR head including the real constraint workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Semantic correctness: every constraint kind computes deterministic results through closed-form applications with explicit typed failure behavior (LOCK-007 — unknown kinds, arity/anchor violations, non-positive dimensional values, targets outside the constrained vocabulary and mixed distance declarations are rejected with stable codes; ambiguity on degenerate geometry declines rather than guessing; the structural over-constraint create gate rejects redundant constraints naming the conflict).

Solver honesty: the six solve outcomes are explicit, reproducible and honest — solved (fully constrained), under-constrained (remaining declared DoF reported), over-constrained (structural redundancy or a fixed-geometry conflict), unsatisfied (a violated constraint after the deterministic pass bound), ambiguous (a degenerate closed form), unsupported (a target that left the vocabulary); satisfaction is COMPUTED on demand, never persisted stale.

Associative composition: constraint changes propagate to dependent geometry AND associative dimensions re-measure from canonical element identities inside the SAME atomic revision (one revision = one undo entry); constraint edits remain deterministic across repeated runs, undo/redo and save/open; canonical identities never change through solves.

Constraint-aware editing: transform edits re-solve the affected components with fixed-restore (a moved fixed entity returns to its pinned state, echoed); re-topologizing edits (trim/extend/break/fillet/chamfer/join) and deletions SEVER the broken constraints with explicit echoes; copies and array items carry NO constraint bindings (constraints bind the source canonical identities — documented and echoed).

Identity honesty: constraint identities are document-minted, monotonic and never reused (con-NNNNNN, the blk-/xr- pattern); the snapshot and history stay canonical-minimal so legacy documents and the pinned CAD-PARITY-002/004/005/006 fixtures remain byte-identical.

Host parity: Web and Electron run the SAME shared constraints core (vocabulary, solver, cascades, glyph painter, palette diagnostics) and produce the identical semantic command stream + save sha for the pinned 007 fixture (LOCK-004).

Deployed verification: the exact PR head is deployed to Vercel and the deployed build reproduces ALL FIVE parity fixtures byte-identically plus the real constraint workflow through the deployed browser (zero page errors).
Boundary discipline: no OCCT/FreeCAD/IfcOpenShell imports enter the renderer/workspace/CADDocument/App API (the LOCK-018 scan covers the constraints core); no protected architecture artifacts change.
non_goals: General-purpose nonlinear optimization or numeric relaxation solvers.
Architecture changes (Architecture v1.1 and the CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 stay FROZEN).
risk_assumptions: The bounded propagation solver resolves typical chain topologies within the deterministic pass bound; pathological oscillations terminate at the bound with the honest unsatisfied outcome (verified by the contradictory-dimensionals test).

Anchor-level constraint addressing is limited to the canonical anchors (start/end/center/midpoint) of the constrained vocabulary — per-vertex polyline constraints are out of scope for this slice (typed declines).

The DoF accounting is the declared bounded formula (line 4, circle 3, arc 5, point 2; each constraint removes its declared DoF) — rigidity analysis is out of scope; the classification it drives is deterministic and reproducible.
Constraint bindings do not travel to COPY/ARRAY items (constraints bind the source canonical identities) — the honest bounded rule, echoed by the commands.
MIRROR on block instances remains the CAD-PARITY-006 typed decline; ARRAY of instances composes placements exactly.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated suites for the constraints vocabulary (the grammar, the typed declines, anchor resolution, DoF accounting), the solver (every closed form with the authority/fixed-flip rules, the six outcomes explicit + reproducible, the fixed-restore cascade, determinism) and the document model (con- minting, the four edit variants with exact inverses incl. key-adding updates, canonical-minimal snapshot/history with legacy byte-identity, replay integrity, open-time validation).

The App API/command surface: constraint.create/update/remove/solve + constraints.list/diagnostics, the over-constraint create gate, the constraint-aware editing cascades composed with the annotation remeasure, severance on delete/trim, the ARRAY ops and the prompt-engine flows for all six commands.

The pinned CAD-PARITY-007 parity fixture asserted by BOTH hosts (the web prompt-engine smoke AND the Electron real-UI smoke over CDP) with the identical save sha AND the identical semantic command stream; the 002/004/005/006 fixtures stay byte-identical.
CI: the cad-parity-007 workflow green on the PR head (the full app suite with both real engines + all five web smokes + fourteen electron smokes).

Deployed Vercel verification of the exact PR head: all five fixtures byte-identical against the deployed build + the deployed constraints protocol + the deployed browser protocol with the real constraint workflow and zero page errors.
